newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro to upgrade Hydro Agri plant.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro to upgrade Hydro Agri plant.

text.p: Norwegian industrial giant Norsk Hydro ASA said on Monday it would invest 600 million crowns to upgrade its Hydro Agri ammonia plant at Porsgrunn in southern Norway.
The company said it would increase the plant's capacity to 1,450 tonnes per day from 1,250 tonnes per day.
Hydro said the upgrade will reduce most of the discharge of nitrogen to water and also reduce energy consumption.
The work will be carried out in connection with a planned revision stop in August and September 1998. Construction will last two to three months.
It said the work will cut Prosgrunn's import need of ammonia -- of around 150,000 tonnes per year -- by about 50 percent.
